product_metadata.title: 50 Feet Green Tinsel Garland Artificial Christmas Pine Decorative Garland Greenery Tinsel Stems Non-Lit Soft Twist Garland 12 Inch x 2Inch for Holiday Season Outdoor Indoor Party Decorations
features: Dimensions: The artificial Christmas garland measures appr. 50 ft(L) x 3.54 in(W). This garland is a universal size and 49 ft length is long enough for decorating use.
Quantity: One package includes 50 ft Christmas decorative garland.
Material: These green tinsel garland are made of lightly textured plastic, which are wire based stems that have a bendable core that can be twisted into lots of ornaments.

Design: This artificial Christmas pine garland seems like realistic-looking branches that are fully posable. Designed with a hidden iron wire, these sturdy ties securely fasten garlands to banisters or porch rails while blending in beautifully with your holiday decoration.

Applications: Mold these pine stems to decorate a variety of natural holiday craft projects, photo frames, wreaths, mini candle ring, gift wrapping, table setting and more. This lighted pine garland will be the perfect addition to your home during the holiday season.
